title: Derived direct-image comparisons commute with open restriction and reassociation
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of positive characteristic different from $\ell$, a fixed algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, and a finite intermediate extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. All schemes below are separated and finite type over $k$, and all morphisms are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda=E$ or $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with the pulled-back condensed coefficient rings $\Lambda_T$ and the finite-subextension convention of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring; sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed; sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the ordinary unbounded categories $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$ and their total right derived module direct images [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories; sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. Write $\kappa_{g,f}:R(gf)_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rg_*Rf_*$ for the resolution-normalized comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. Then:

1. For $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ\xrightarrow hT$, the two maps from $R(hgf)_*$ to $Rh_*Rg_*Rf_*$ agree:
$$ (Rh_*\kappa_{g,f})\circ\kappa_{h,gf}=(\kappa_{h,g}Rf_*)\circ\kappa_{hg,f}. $$
2. For $f:S\to T$ and a quasi-compact open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow T$, put $S_U=S\times_TU$, with open $j_S:S_U\hookrightarrow S$ and restricted map $f_U:S_U\to U$. There is a natural isomorphism
$$\rho_{f,j}:j^*Rf_*\xrightarrow{\sim}R(f_U)_*j_S^*.$$
For a K-injective representative $I$ of an object of $D_S$ [def-pur-kinjective-complex], this is the class of the canonical underived restriction isomorphism $j^*f_*I\cong(f_U)_*j_S^*I$, whose value on a site object $V\to U$ is the identity on $I(V\times_T S)$. Module structures are transported along the inverse coefficient-ring comparisons of [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients].
3. These restriction isomorphisms commute with successive open restrictions. They also commute with composition: for $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gT$ and $j:U\hookrightarrow T$, let $j_Y:Y_U\hookrightarrow Y$, $j_X:X_U\hookrightarrow X$ be the pulled-back opens. The two maps from $j^*R(gf)_*$ to $R(g_U)_*R(f_U)_*j_X^*$ agree:
$$ (R(g_U)_*\rho_{f,j_Y})\circ(\rho_{g,j}Rf_*)\circ(j^*\kappa_{g,f})=(\kappa_{g_U,f_U}j_X^*)\circ\rho_{gf,j}. $$
All formulas insert the canonical functor associators and fibre-product identifications; for identity maps and identity open immersions the comparisons are identities.
